<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ent "<!ENTITY internal 'Expanded Text'>">
  %ent;
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY ext SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
<?pi-target data="value"?>
]>
<root xmlns="http://example.org/ns" xmlns:sub="http://example.org/sub" sub:id="1">
  <!-- Comment with special characters <>&'" -->
  <?pi-target2 processing instruction data?>
  <child>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section containing <tags>, &entities; inside, and ]]> characters if escaped or split.
    ]]>
  </child>
  <sub:child>&internal;</sub:child>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE doc [
  <!ELEMENT doc (section+)>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY e1 "First Entity">
  <!ENTITY e2 "&e1; and Second">
  <!ENTITY % param "<!ENTITY pe 'Parameter Entity Value'>">
  %param;
  <?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
]>
<doc xmlns="http://example.org/base" xmlns:xml="http://www.w3.org/XML/1998/namespace">
  <!-- Multiple comments preceding processing instructions -->
  <?target-pi attr="val"?>
  <section>
    <![CDATA[
      First CDATA block with complex markup: <xml attr="test">&e2;</xml>
    ]]>
  </section>
  <section>&pe;</section>
</doc>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent1 "Value 1">
  <!ENTITY ent2 "&ent1; Value 2">
  <!NOTATION txt SYSTEM "text/plain">
  <!ENTITY file SYSTEM "data.txt" NDATA txt>
  <?custom-pi data="test"?>
]>
<catalog xmlns="http://example.org/catalog" xmlns:m="http://example.org/metadata" m:version="2.0">
  <!-- Top-level documentation comment -->
  <m:info>
    <?meta-pi command="refresh"?>
    <![CDATA[
      <!-- Nested-looking comment inside CDATA -->
      <m:data>&ent2;</m:data>
    ]]>
  </m:info>
  <item>&ent2;</item>
</catalog>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE database [
  <!ELEMENT database (record*)>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % external-macro SYSTEM "external.ent">
  %external-macro;
  <!ENTITY ref "Standard Reference">
  <?xml-model href="schema.rng" type="application/xml-relax-ng"?>
]>
<database xmlns="http://example.org/db" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Comment about the database structure -->
  <?db-control action="init"?>
  <record xlink:type="simple" xlink:href="http://example.org">
    <![CDATA[
      Raw data: <record>nested tags</record> &ref;
    ]]>
  </record>
  <record>&ref;</record>
</database>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE container [
  <!ELEMENT container (node*)>
  <!ELEMENT node (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY sample "Sample Entity">
  <!ENTITY compound "&sample; & More">
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY doc-file "manual.pdf" NDATA pdf>
  <?xml-space preserve?>
]>
<container xmlns="http://example.org/container" xmlns:ns="http://example.org/ns" ns:att="value">
  <!-- Comment block before complex CDATA and namespaces -->
  <?process-instruction param="1"?>
  <node>
    <![CDATA[
      Some raw CDATA text with <brackets> and &s;
    ]]>
  </node>
  <ns:node>&compound;</ns:node>
</container>
```
